component.name: jsBudbrainsVisualizerEQ
component.summary: An equalizer for all your sound, with animations that move to the music

description.p: Make everything you hear sound just the way you like it – music, films, games and calls – and watch your music come alive on the screen.
The animations follow the beat and keep changing, so there is always something new to see. Turn them into a light show on the whole screen, or let them play quietly beside your work.
Find your sound in a moment and keep your favourites. One click brings back the original sound whenever you want it.

description.p: Picture and sound now stay perfectly in sync, everything runs smoother while using far less processor power, shapes and figures morph into one another, new 3D laser shows, and the level display keeps surprising you with new appearances.

A flight through an endless maze, a bass drum detection that hits on time with any sound profile, a notice for photosensitive people with a switch that reduces flashes, and the window now opens centred on first start.
Many new animations and effects that blend into one another, a beat detection that follows the drums, and a level display that moves with the picture.
